candidates.description: This vector activates on various combinations of closing curly brackets, parentheses, and associated punctuation marks.
This vector is related to mathematical symbols and typesetting commands commonly used in LaTeX.
This vector represents backslash characters and syntactic tokens commonly associated with programming or mathematical notation.
These tokens represent common LaTeX formatting commands and mathematical notation delimiters used for superscripts, subscripts, and braces.
These tokens represent mathematical symbols, Greek letters, and variables commonly used in scientific and quantitative notation.
These tokens represent mathematical and logical operators used in equations, expressions, and programming.
This feature vector activates on LaTeX formatting commands, mathematical symbols, and Devanagari script characters used in multilingual typesetting.
This vector is related to subword tokens and linguistic scripts across multiple languages.
This vector activates for Hindi and Sanskrit characters, mathematical notation, and sub-word text fragments with noise.

This feature vector represents the processing of the Devanagari character 'क' (ka) and its associated vowel-modifier combinations, along with the Latin character 'k' and tokenization fragments representing the [k] phoneme.
